1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback succeeded (`rolled_out`), and post-rollback status confirms the service is now **healthy** (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 in all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action. The first attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to ensure no duplicate incident was created; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required — the rollback was to a previously healthy production version.
